title: fix(runtime,plugin-security): the declared-webhook activation door switches one of two holders a namespace cannot tell apart, and the upgrade report names each withheld holder
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoMEcsa8u1Ymjwvb5h8WsfW2)_

Refs #33016 (items 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8)

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:声明式 webhook 的激活门 `POST /security/_activation/webhook/NAME` 新增 `?package=PKG` 精确限定,能单独开关同名的两个持有者之一;升级影响报告对每个持有者(含被禁用的第二个)各报一条,并给出每条都能用的开关地址;两条平台测试清单与 liveness 证据改到新的 `declared:PKG/NAME` 引用。
- 为什么改:同一命名空间的两个共有包(或无命名空间的包旁边另有持有者)同时声明一个 webhook 名时两者都在派发,但裸地址与命名空间地址都只答 409,运维无法单独关掉其中一个;两条清单项会把正确的产品判失败。
- 风险与回滚:只放宽一个原本 400 的查询参数,其余答复不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR,不涉及数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts`(`resolveExactWebhook` 与查询集)、`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/upgrade-impact-report.ts`(`webhookShippers`)、`packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation-door.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/catalog-activation-door.test.ts`,应见两个注册顺序下 `?package=` 各写自己的一行、两扇门都 409 点名双方。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Item 1 (S1), the door.** Two holders the namespace address cannot tell apart, two co-owners of one namespace or a package that declares no namespace beside another holder, are both served and both dispatched, and both `webhook/NAME` and `webhook/NS/NAME` answer `409` naming both, so neither could be switched. The bare address now takes `?package=PKG` (`resolveExactWebhook`, `WEBHOOK_DOOR_QUERY_PARAMS` in `packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts`), the exact qualifier `/meta` reads (ADR-0150 D2) and the permission-set door already takes: it addresses exactly PKG's served declaration and writes PKG's own `(webhook, package_id, name)` row (`WEBHOOK_LEDGER_ADDRESSING`), the row naming no package left as it is under two holders and taken over under one (D8, `webhookAdoptsPackageless`). A PKG that does not serve the name, a disabled one included, is `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` `not-held-by-qualifier` naming the served holders, or `404` when nothing serves it. `package` is the one query parameter of the bare webhook address (AGENTS route rule 5, read by the shared `readPermissionSetPackageQuery`); the namespace address takes none.

FROM → TO rows (Clause-② widening):
- `POST /security/_activation/webhook/NAME?package=PKG`, PKG serving NAME: FROM `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (unknown query parameter) TO `200`, PKG's row written, `data.packageId` = PKG.
- Same, PKG not serving NAME: FROM `400` TO `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the holders (or `404` when no enabled package declares NAME). Nothing written.
- `POST /security/_activation/webhook/NS/NAME?package=…`: `400` before and after.

**Item 2 (S3).** Pinned: B disabled beside A enabled, B's namespace address is `409` naming A (no code change).

**Item 3 (S5).** `integration-system.webhook-lifecycle` (steps[1]) and `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony` (acceptance[5].verify) expect `ref_id declared:com.example.showcase/showcase_task_changed`, as `packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts` pins; each item's revision and history bumped.

**Item 4 (nit 1).** `packages/spec/liveness/webhook.json` `name` evidence: one slot per served `(package, name)` holder and `declaredWebhookRefId(name, packageId)`.

**Item 5 (nit 2).** The upgrade-impact report's switch line (`SWITCH_DOORS`) and withheld-webhook line name `webhook/NAME?package=PACKAGE`, which every packaged finding can use whatever its namespace, or the bare address for a finding that names no package, where they named the namespace address.

**Item 6 (nit 3).** `webhookShippers` also counts each holder `packageScopedHoldersOf(…, { includeDisabledPackages: true })` answers, confirmed against its own code artifact (`shipsAt`), so a disabled second holder gets its withheld finding. FROM one finding (the holder the bare artifact lookup answered) TO one finding per holder.

**Item 7.** Not in this PR: a security item is with the owner seat.

**Item 8 (nit 4).** Pinned: one holder with its own row beside a row naming no package, the bare address writes the holder's own row (no code change).

**Responsibility.** Producing code: the runtime activation door (`handleCatalogActivationWrite`) and plugin-security's boot report (`collectUpgradeImpactFindings`). Existing platform path: none switched one of two holders a namespace cannot tell apart; a package disable or a hand-written ledger row were the only stops. Reached by: an operator (`manage_metadata`, the platform operator under a wall) whose deployment holds two such webhook holders, rare; the report and checklist lines by every boot and every checklist run.

**Rulings quoted.** Epic ruling 6842178655 on PR #32577 ("Follow-up card (p2), not this PR") files these items; ADR-0150 D2 (`?package=` is the exact qualifier), D4 (one row per holder), D5 (qualified addresses), D8 (a row naming no package is the one holder's). Surface grep `ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔` hits: `catalog-activation.ts` 8 (ADR-0131 seeder ruling, #22621 → A, ADR-0150 D2 ruling, epic ruling MF1 ×3, four ⛔ door limits), `upgrade-impact-report.ts` 1 (the ruling on #24443), `webhook.json` 3 (the #7131 previews ruling, the spec-only override note); none is touched by this diff.

**File-surface breaches (seat extended the surface):** `packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` (one sentence on the `webhook/:ns/:name` row naming `?package=`) and `content/docs/automation/webhooks.mdx` (one sentence naming the exact qualifier).

## Red lines

1. **Resolution is never loosened.** The bare and namespace addresses of two holders still refuse `409` naming both, in both registration orders (`catalog-activation-door.test.ts` › `[FROM 409 TO switched] … registered alpha, beta` and `… registered beta, alpha`); `?package=` resolves only an exact served holder and refuses every other PKG naming the holders (`… a package that does not hold the name is 409 …`, `… a disabled package holds nothing …`); the bare read of two co-owners still throws the 409 naming both (`declared-webhooks.test.ts` › `two co-owners of one namespace, registered alpha, beta` / `beta, alpha`).
2. **Ambiguity is reported, never guessed.** Under two holders a `?package=` write never takes over the row naming no package (`[null, false]` kept beside the holder's own row in both orders); the report names each holder rather than the first one found (`upgrade-impact-report.test.ts` › `[FROM one TO each] registered com.acme.crm, com.acme.addon …` and the reversed order).
3. **Independently releasable.** The phase-1 one-holder pins stay green (`CONTROL — one holder: the bare address answers as before …`, `CONTROL — one holder: its namespace address writes the same row`, `CONTROL — one holder: \`?package=\` writes the row the bare address writes …`, `[FROM 409 TO written] one holder with its own row beside a row naming no package …`); bare-name URL behaviour is unchanged (every pre-existing door test unmodified and green); no migration and no ADR-0087 entry: no stored shape or authorable key moves.

## Tests

- New: `catalog-activation-door.test.ts` 8 cases (S3, the `?package=` describe ×6 incl. both orders, nit 4); `declared-webhooks.test.ts` 2 (two co-owners, both orders); `upgrade-impact-report.test.ts` 2 (disabled second holder, both orders) + 1 rewritten (the remedy names the exact-qualifier address).
- Ablations (each mutation landed on disk via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, test imports resolve to `src/`, restored blob == HEAD):
  - the webhook query set put back to empty ⇒ 5 red (`registered alpha, beta`, `registered beta, alpha`, `a package that does not hold the name …`, `a disabled package holds nothing …`, `CONTROL — one holder: ?package= …`);
  - the disabled-holder count removed from `webhookShippers` ⇒ 2 red (both registration orders);
  - the namespace address put back in the switch line ⇒ 1 red (`… the remedy names the exact-qualifier address`).

## Acceptance notes

- `plugin-webhooks`' own remedies (the name guard and the redelivery veto, `declaredWebhookActivationPath`) still name the slot's namespace address, as ruled for #31699 round 2; for two co-owners of one namespace that address answers `409`, and `?package=` is the one that switches. Not changed here (a ruled text); the seat decides whether it is a follow-up.
- Item 7's probe result is with the owner seat.

## Verification

All readings at head `c68c098f0` (branch base `4c152685`, `origin/main` `f45c0125` merged once; full `pnpm build` green, 119/119 tasks).

<details><summary>Tests and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck && test` (after the merge): Test Files 597 passed (597), Tests 10617 passed, 19 skipped; lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security --filter @objectstack/plugin-webhooks test` (before the merge, which touched neither): Test Files 267 passed and 25 passed; Tests 6607 passed (45 skipped) and 294 passed.
- `typecheck` of `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/plugin-webhooks`: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 105 families; all 105 run with stdin closed, every exit code 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 105 derived, 105 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Outside the derivation, also run: `pnpm lint` exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` exit 0.
- First run (before the merge) found two real problems, fixed in `95e17a456`: `check:platform-checklist` wanted each item's top-level `revision` bumped with its history entry. Its three exit-3 prerequisite refusals (`check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, the teardown-shape self-test's fixture commit) and `check:dts-closure` were local build-state, cleared by the full build and the fixture fetch; all four exit 0 on the final run.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations</summary>

Each via `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0 on disk, restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty); the suites import `src/` directly.

1. `catalogActivationQueryParams`: the webhook bare address's `package` taken away ⇒ `catalog-activation-door.test.ts` 5 failed / 84 passed.
2. `webhookShippers`: the disabled-holder loop's add removed ⇒ `upgrade-impact-report.test.ts` 2 failed / 43 passed.
3. `WEBHOOK_SWITCH_DOOR`: the namespace address put back ⇒ 1 failed / 44 passed.

</details>
